services.desc: Our Dolphin and Donuts tour is a great way to start the day. Duration 2 Hours About Please arrive 30 mins prior to scheduled departure for check in! This tour features donuts and coffee from a locally owned and operated business. This tour heads north from Siesta Key Marina and focuses on finding dolphin, manatee (seasonal), and a wide array of aquatic birds. Cruising along the Intercostal Waterway north you will step back in time to see mangrove islands packed with pelicans, herons, spoonbills, ibis, osprey, and even bald eagles.
